derivation: from the base of G5007 (τάλαντον) and a derivative of the base of G3984 (πεῖρα);

occurrences.text: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?
Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
